subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw add Markdown code-fence hygiene to workspace file writes, and if so should it be default auto-fix, warn/doctor-only, opt-in, or outside the core write path?
rationale: The request changes write-time semantics for user-authored files and adds config/skip API surface; prior implementation attempts were closed unmerged after correctness concerns, so maintainer intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Require warn or opt-in design first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved design avoids default silent mutation and proves parser safety against nested fence examples.

options.title: Approve default auto-fix
options.body: Allow a future PR to mutate workspace Markdown on write by default, with parser-backed tests, config docs, and upgrade/proof coverage.

options.title: Reject core write-time mutation
options.body: Close or redirect the idea toward manual docs linting, doctor lint, Skill Workshop guidance, or a plugin/workflow outside core writes.

recommendation.title: Require warn or opt-in design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved design avoids default silent mutation and proves parser safety against nested fence examples.
